caption:
Delighted and an honor to deliver the keynote at the Opening Ceremony at the 2025 Global Energy Interconnection Conference in Beijing on behalf of UNDP - a gathering that comes at a pivotal moment for the global energy transition.

One message stood out clearly: clean energy is no longer tomorrow’s promise. It is today’s most powerful tool for jobs, growth and true energy security. In 2023, the sector employed 16 million people worldwide, with China alone accounting for 7.4 million - nearly half the global total. By 2030, clean energy and efficiency could generate 70 million new jobs, with each $1 million invested in renewables creating nearly three times more jobs than fossil fuels

The shift is already reshaping economies. In 2023, clean energy accounted for 10% of global GDP growth - rising to 20% in China and nearly one-third in the EU. The question now is not whether the transition is happening, but how fast we can scale it and how effectively we can ensure its benefits reach the people who need them most.

It was in this context that @UNDP and @GEIDCO announced a new MoU: a commitment to deepen collaboration on innovative finance, South–South cooperation and digital solutions that can accelerate a just and inclusive energy transition.

We stand at a moment of great possibility. Clean energy is not only about megawatts—it is about unlocking opportunities to create millions of new jobs and livelihoods. It is a driver of transformative change across our societies, reshaping how we live, produce, and connect. And with the power of digital tools, data, and AI, we can ensure energy security that is smarter, more resilient, and inclusive. Together, we can build an energy future that truly leaves no one behind.

#EnergyForDevelopment #JustTransition #SouthSouthCooperation #GEI2025
